title: Seasonal Staffing: How Target’s Team Gears Up for the Holidays
summary: At Target, we’re heading into the holidays with a strong, experienced team that’s ready to deliver a joyful, reliable shopping experience for our guests — however they choose to shop.
body_markdown:
Q:


How does Target decide how many seasonal team members it plans to hire?


A:


We start with our current team, offering team members opportunities to work additional hours, if desired. We also leverage our On Demand team in stores, a flexible workforce of nearly 43,000 team members who can pick up shifts that work for their schedules. We then hire seasonal team members based on local demand across our stores and supply chain facilities.


Q:


What specific positions will you hire for? What are the roles and responsibilities for these seasonal positions?


A:


Seasonal team members fill a number of roles at Target, with the majority in our stores stocking shelves, curating our style departments, helping guests during checkout and assisting with online order fulfillment. Working alongside and learning from our experienced teams, they help deliver an easy, inspiring and friendly experience for guests throughout the holiday season.


In our supply chain facilities, seasonal team members work on the frontlines of getting products to our stores and guests quickly and reliably, helping create greater ease for guests and fellow team members.


Q:


What is the On Demand program? Are all team members, including seasonal workers, able to work On Demand?


A:


Over the past few years, we have successfully established an On Demand team in our stores — a flexible workforce that includes nearly 43,000 store team members — who have the option to pick up shifts on an as-desired basis to fit their schedule.


All current store team members have the option to talk to their leader about shifting to an On Demand role, and seasonal team members in our stores also have this option following the holiday season. We don’t currently offer On Demand positions in our supply chain facilities.


Q:


What wages and benefits are available to seasonal team members?


A:


Target team members, including our seasonal team members, are offered a starting wage range of $15–$24 an hour depending on role and location. From day one, team members have access to competitive health, well-being and financial benefits, including 24/7 virtual healthcare through CirrusMD, confidential mental health support and coaching through Spring Health (with eight sessions for each service at no cost), backup child care services through Bright Horizons when their usual care arrangements are temporarily unavailable, early pay access with DailyPay, a 10% discount at all Target stores and on Target.com, plus an extra 20% off select wellness items and 20% off adult owned-brand apparel and accessories at Target.


Q:


What does the application process look like?


A:


Interested candidates can visit[TargetSeasonalJobs.com](https://corporate.target.com/careers/seasonal) today to explore seasonal opportunities and apply.


For store positions, pre-recorded video and online interviews will once again be used this year. For supply chain positions, candidates will submit applications and online assessments.


Target is committed to accommodating applicants and candidates who need assistance with the interview process. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out tocandidate.accommodations@HRHelp.Target.com . Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.
